symptom: reading my IIO accelerometer buffer gives fewer samples than requested and occasionally garbage. I do a raw read() of /dev/iio:device0 with a fixed byte count that ignores the scan_size.

gold.diagnosis: The IIO buffer returns whole scan elements whose size is in_voltage0_scale-derived scan_size, not a fixed 4 bytes. A fixed-length read misaligns samples and returns partial/garbage data. Compute the byte count from scan_size (and number of enabled channels) and read in whole-scan units, checking the returned byte count.
